National Legal Aid Clinic for Women (NLACW) Core Support 2025-2029

description.narrative: NLACW:s mål är ”Förbättrad tillgång till rättvisa för utsatta och underprivilegierade kvinnor och barn till 2029”. Målet kommer att uppnås genom ökad juridisk kunskap, stärkt representation och opinionsbildning för lagreformer.

NLACW’s goal is increased equitable access to justice for vulnerable and under privileged women and children by 2029. This will be done through legal literacy, representation and advocacy for policy and law reform.

Strategic Goal: Increased equitable access to justice for vulnerable and under privileged women and children by 2029.
Strategic Objective 1: Targeted women and children are aware of their legal and human rights and are making informed decisions to protect their rights.
Strategic Objective 2: Vulnerable and underprivileged women and children have equitable access to legal representation and obtain justice from the legal system.
Strategic Objective 3: Policy and legal framework responsive to the needs of the women and children.
Strategic Objective 4: NLACW has sufficient and sustainable capacity to deliver legal aid services to vulnerable and under privileged women and children.
